text:
sam_support: FYI — BetaApp escalated: p99 latency spike + 503s on /v1/generate starting ~08:40 UTC. They also see intermittent auth failures and a billing usage surge. Customer is panicking.

sam_support: quick numbers from their dashboard: p95 warped from 0.26s -> 1.2s, p99 from 1.8s -> 6.5s, 503s ~2.3% of requests over last 30m.

nina_runtime: can you paste a few request_ids and which model + region? Also did they change prompt sizes/concurrency?

sam_support: request_ids: r-33f2, r-33f8, r-3410. Model: redwood-3b-quant-v1, region: us-west-2. No deliberate client changes reported; they do batch several user messages into long contexts (~8k tokens sometimes).

sam_support: attaching small excerpt from API logs: 
```
[08:41:12] r-33f2 503 "alloc failed" tenant=betaapp shard=shard-42
[08:41:13] r-33f8 200 latency=6200ms kv_cache_size=18GB slab_free=0
[08:41:14] r-3410 200 latency=4500ms evict_count=12345
[08:42:02] OOM_WARNING slab_frag=87% gpu_mem_used=100% node=gpu-14a
```

ana_sre: seeing node metrics correlate: gpu-14a shows high fragmentation and sustained slab pressure. KV store for tenant betaapp has grown ~2.1GB in last hour, many long-lived keys (per-conversation prefix). Looks like KV growth + long contexts -> allocator churn -> slow path + occasional alloc failures.

ana_sre: immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-tenant active fallback to smaller model (redwood-1.3b) for betaapp, 2) apply soft throttle to context length > 2048 tokens for that tenant, 3) bump eviction aggressiveness for tenant's KV (ttl=30m for non-recent prefixes).

tom_oncall: +1 to fallback + TTL. Also recommended temporary node-level action: restart shard-42 after draining (drain / reassign in 5min window) to flush fragmented slabs if we can't reclaim quickly. Restart is lower-risk than full cluster rolling.

nina_runtime: commands to check kv heatmap and allocations: 
```
curl -s "https://internal.mgmt/kv/usage?tenant=betaapp&since=60m" | jq .heatmap
kubectl exec -it admin-tool -- /bin/sh -c "rtctl slab-stats --shard=shard-42 --format=json"
```

priya_devrel: I'll message BetaApp about temporary routing to smaller model and context throttling, and ask for 3 example prompts that reproduce the long contexts. Need a clear repro to test allocator changes.

sam_support: sent customer the change window note (ETA 09:05 UTC) and asked for sample prompts. BetaApp responded with two long transcripts and confirmed some automated agent is concatenating context without trimming.

ana_sre: after draining shard-42 and restarting, we saw immediate p99 improvement from ~6.5s -> ~2.1s in that shard, but still elevated across cluster because other shards have hot KV partitions. Suggest we run targeted compaction/defrag and deploy allocator patch.

nina_runtime: quick runtime tweak we can flip now: lower per-alloc overhead by toggling `runtime.slab.compact_threshold=0.6` and increase eviction tick: `runtime.kv.eviction.multiplier=1.5` for tenant betaapp. I'll stage the change to canary shards first.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: change-set 83c9a2 applied to canary shards (3/3) — https://deploys.internal/redwood/83c9a2

nina_runtime: canary metrics look good: slab_frag reduced to ~72% on canaries, p99 on canaries down to 1.4s. No new OOMs. Rolling to remaining shards with 3-min interval.

ana_sre: long-term plan items: 1) add automated per-tenant KV TTL heuristics (detect long-lived conversational prefixes), 2) allocator improvement PR to compact more aggressively under sustained high fragmentation, 3) add tenant-aware routing to limit concurrency for heavy contexts, 4) documentation for customers about trimming context and recommended token limits per model.

tom_oncall: also flag billing team: unexpected billing surge for BetaApp while they were impacted — could be due to retries on client side. Recommend billing hold + credit until we confirm root cause and repro. @finance please advise.

priya_devrel: noted — I asked BetaApp to pause automated retry logic and to confirm they will trim old turns. They agreed to pause retries for 1 hour.

sam_support: follow-up plan: 1) confirm full cluster roll completed (nina), 2) monitor p95/p99 for 2 hours, 3) schedule allocator PR review + canary next week (ana), 4) billing follow-up with finance + customer statement. Will update customer in 30m with progress.

nina_runtime: full roll finished at 09:22 UTC. cluster p99 back to ~1.3s, p95 ~0.35s. Eviction reduced KV growth rate for betaapp by ~80%.

ana_sre: closing note: root cause = tenant-driven KV growth + long contexts causing sustained allocator fragmentation -> slow-path allocations and occasional alloc failures/503s. Mitigations: active fallback, TTLs, slab compaction tweak, shard drain/restart. Long-term: allocator compaction PR + tenant-aware KV heuristics.

sam_support: thanks team — I'll send a postmortem-style summary to BetaApp and mark this as customer escalated -> mitigated. We will track allocator PR and billing credits separately. :thumbsup:
